title: Strix launches AI hacker agents to test vibe-coded apps live #strix #aipentesting #cybersecurity
description: Strix launched a free open-source AI pen-testing tool that simulates hacker attacks on vibe-coded apps. It uses specialized AI agents to perform live, targeted security tests, identifying real vulnerabilities with proof and suggested fixes. This approach moves beyond traditional scans that list potential bugs by actively exploiting weaknesses, giving developers actionable insights. Strix’s innovation enhances app security by enabling thorough testing before deployment, reducing the risk of real cyberattacks. By offering this tool for free and hosting it on GitHub with over 45,000 stars, Strix is advancing the accessibility of AI-driven cybersecurity solutions in the developer community and fostering safer software development practices. #Strix #AIpentesting #vibecoded #opensource #cybersecurity #appsecurity #AItools #githubstars #penetrationtesting #infosec #cyberdefense #securitytesting #softwaredevelopment #ethicalhacking #AIsecurity
